title: Transport Hom complexes through the open-subscheme equivalence
statement: Let Y be a scheme, U an open of Y, and L and M arbitrary integer-indexed cochain complexes of O_Y-modules. Assume that the over-open equivalence F = Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U carries each internal Hom(A,B) to internal Hom(F(A),F(B)) by isomorphisms e(A,B), natural for every precomposition A' -> A and postcomposition B -> B'. Then degreewise scheme restriction res_U carries Hom^bullet_Y(L,M) to Hom^bullet_U(res_U L,res_U M), up to an isomorphism of cochain complexes. The comparison follows from the open-site restriction theorem [lem-sc-hom-complex-restrict-open] and the product/differential description [def-pur-hom-complex].

source.place: Tag 08DL and Tag 0A8X, transport of the ordinary Hom complex

proof.text: Use the open-site Hom-complex comparison and preserve the integer-indexed products under the equivalence.

Use the supplied naturality hypothesis and the projection differential formula to identify both signed differential summands. Assemble the degreewise product isomorphisms using isoOfComponents, then compose with overFunctorEquiv on the Hom complex and both inputs.

theorem homComplex_restrict_scheme_of_homIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (U : Y.Opens)
    (L M : CochainComplex Y.Modules ℤ)
    (e : ∀ (A B : SheafOfModules.{u} (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U)),
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj
        (SheafOfModules.homObj (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf.over U) A B) ≅
      SheafOfModules.homObj (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj A)
        ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.obj B))
    (he : ∀ (A A' B B' : SheafOfModules.{u} (Y.ringCatSheaf.over U))
      (f : A' ⟶ A) (g : B ⟶ B'),
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map
          (SheafOfModules.homObjMap (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf.over U) f g) ≫
        (e A' B').hom =
      (e A B).hom ≫ SheafOfModules.homObjMap
        (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map f)
        ((Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U).functor.map g)) :
    Nonempty (
      ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (homComplex (R := Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf) L M) ≅
      homComplex (R := U.toScheme.toRingedSpace.sheaf)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L)
        (((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M))
